Your final output should be an integer representing the total number of lines containing the word "Linux" in all these .txt files.'

cat > experiment/file1.txt << 'EOF'
Hello Linux world

EOF
cat > experiment/file2.txt << 'EOF'

EOF
cat > experiment/subdir/file3.txt << 'EOF'

Linux
EOF
grep -r "Linux" experiment --include="*.txt" | wc -l
